name: Red Carnation
source:
"Congratulations! The love of your life has you locked up in her basement, ready to lavish you with endless affection and attention. The only price you have to pay in return? Your autonomy! Give up your identity and be her perfect "Aster" replacement."

***
Freesia finds herself in what appears to be her brother's room, smothered in her brother's girlfriend's embrace. The girl she's been pining for finally decided to give her her love, but the price of having to live life as her brother is too steep for Freesia to be willing to pay.

Red Carnarion is an 18+ NSFW yuri (girls love) VN featuring two girls committed to realizing their love even if by grotesque means. Would you accept love knowing it's only "yours" when you forsake yourself?
